title: AAP Capability Grant Token claim set (AAP-SPEC section 4.2)
description: Claims of the CGT, ratified byte-for-byte from the reference broker assertion (Secretless src/broker/cpi/assertion.ts). `iss` is the minting broker's issuer identifier, `sub` the agent DID from the verified ATX, `aud`/`scope` the downstream audience and OAuth scope, `trust_class` the ATX capability (abstract trust class) exercised for this grant, `issuer_chain`/`trust_level` the federation attributes carried for v2 cross-broker verification. AAP-SPEC 0.5 adds `authorization_details` (RFC 9396, structured grant entries typed by the section 4.4 registry), `aap_crit` (section 4.5, the claims a verifier must understand or reject) and `cnf` (RFC 7800, presenter key binding, section 4.6); all three are additive, so a token that omits them is byte-identical to its 0.4 form and the claim schema stays at v1. `fga_constraints` is deprecated in 0.5 (replaced by `authorization_details`; no implementation minted it) and stays defined so the -00/-01 text and the reference verifiers keep validating. The other optional members (`intent_verified`, `max_uses`, `context_required`) are optional-to-ignore (AAP broker profile section 8.3) and are not minted by the v1 reference. The schema pins presence and form; the narrowing rule of section 4.4 (authorization_details never widens scope or trust_class), the attenuation relation of section 5.4 and the aap_crit rejection rule are verifier checks.

fga_constraints.description: DEPRECATED in AAP-SPEC 0.5 (section 4.2); replacedBy `authorization_details`. JSON-encoded FGA policy from the 0.3/0.4 text. Optional-to-ignore: a verifier ignores it. No implementation minted it as of 2026-09-08. Kept so -00/-01 tokens and the reference verifiers keep validating; removal is a later draft's decision.

max_uses.description: DEPRECATED in AAP-SPEC 0.5 (section 4.2); replacedBy `budget.maxUses` inside `authorization_details`. Optional-to-ignore. When both are present `budget.maxUses` MUST NOT exceed `max_uses` (a verifier check).

authorizationDetails.description: RFC 9396 authorization_details: an array of entries, each typed by the AAP-SPEC section 4.4.1 registry. The wire value of `type` is the registry URI `https://specs.opena2a.org/aap/types/<name>` (`<name>` one of mcp_tool, skill, peer_agent, model, network, data, budget); `type` is REQUIRED (RFC 9396 section 2). Per-type members are camelCase (section 9.6); `requiresApproval` MAY appear on every type. The schema pins the common shape and leaves per-type members open because an unknown type is rejected by the aap_crit rule, not by the schema.

aapCrit.description: AAP-SPEC section 4.5: the claim names a verifier MUST understand or reject the token. MUST name `authorization_details` and `cnf` whenever those claims are present; MUST NOT name a claim absent from the token (a verifier check).

cnf.description: RFC 7800 confirmation claim binding the token to the presenter's key (AAP-SPEC section 4.6). Exactly one of `jwk` (RFC 7800 section 3.2) or `jkt` (the RFC 7638 SHA-256 JWK thumbprint, base64url, as registered for `cnf` by RFC 9449).
